summary: BioNTech SE filed a Form 6-K (the US-equivalent foreign private issuer current report) on 2026-11-03 furnishing a development update and interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. Revenue was €1,289.2M for Q3 and €1,512.9M for the nine months, with a Q3 net profit of €184.5M (€0.74 per share) versus a nine-month net loss of €1,168.2M. The filing is an ordinary quarterly earnings report, not a special situation; no transaction terms, board recommendation, or advisor are stated.
